name: mino
description: Local plan protocol, evidence, review, standards, and Git Flow for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Run durable coding plans with evidence and Git Flow.
interface.longDescription: Mino gives coding agents a deterministic local plan state machine, explicit approval boundaries, immutable evidence, standards catalogs, review/rework, and guarded Git Flow.
defaultPrompt: Use $mino to create or resume a durable coding plan.
Use $mino to inspect the active plan and follow its next action.
